structure: Part 23, document upload validation and scan status. Mined all 15 traces the part names, plus both spec files in full (scan-status.fit.spec.js and upload.fit.spec.js). The traces were written by Playwright 1.63, which the trace CLI tim installs refuses to open (TraceVersionError), so each zip was unpacked into this part's working folder and its trace, network and resource files were read directly with jq: action list (before events), full frame snapshots (rendered DOM, attributes, focus targets) and the network log with JSON bodies. Folder map: s1 = scan-status 7c6fb (line 64, safe scan then continue), s2 = 60ccf (line 110, virus found then remove), s3 = 2acb4 (line 149, axe on settled table), s4 = 770d5 (line 169, polling with one settled and one stuck row); u1 = upload 0bd45 (line 223, empty reference), u2 = 246ce (242, reference over 58), u3 = 48101 (269, type placeholder), u4 = 3260a (291, chosen type on saved row), u5 = b1185 (313, empty date), u6 = 25daf (332, impossible date), u7 = aa231 (360, no file), u8 = ed400 (373, ZIP file), u9 = 62e59 (402, client-side oversize), u10 = eefa9 (444, client oversize summary link), u11 = 32cfd (464, server-side oversize). Every trace walks the same set-up path (stub sign-in, dashboard, Start a new notification, Origin of the import, What are you importing?, Commodity details, Overview) and then works on one page: Upload documents (/live-animals/notifications/{ref}/accompanying-documents, caption Documents). States covered on that page: empty form, each server-side validation error (reference empty, reference too long, type not chosen, date empty, impossible date, no file, unsupported type, oversize payload), the client-side oversize error, a saved row in each scan state (Scanning for virus, Check completed, Virus found), the cannot-continue error while a scan is pending, the virus error, removing a row, the poll call to /accompanying-documents/status, the reload to ?attempt=1 once every row has settled, and the in-place update and live announcement while another row is still pending. Exits: Save and continue to Overview. The set-up pages belong to other parts and are not claimed here.

claims.statement: The status endpoint returns every document on the notification with its upload id and scan status.

claims.statement: Once the poll finds every document settled, the page reloads itself at the announcer's settled address (?attempt=1), so the settled state is rendered by the server.
claims.ref: trace documents-fit-scan-status.-7c6fb network GET .../status then GET .../accompanying-documents?attempt=1; trace documents-fit-scan-status.-60ccf and -2acb4 the same
claims.note: In s2 the reloaded page carries data-settled-href ...?attempt=2, so the attempt number goes up with each reload.
